content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

PayPal and Stripe provide robust ecommerce solutions with user-friendly interfaces and a range of features. However, their availability is limited; Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many creators without options. When it comes to Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, these platforms also impose restrictions based on geographic locations, further isolating creators in regions experiencing financial instability. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, offers a complete solution without geographic limitations, empowering creators to build their own stores, manage transactions, and deliver products efficiently.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have strict policies that directly affect creators in restricted countries. For instance, PayPal's account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no possibility of appeal, leaving creators in a dire situation. Stripe's limitations on geographic availability mean that numerous countries are simply unable to use their services. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these restrictions entirely. By utilizing tools such as Cloudflare Pages and Workers, creators can establish a fully operational online store independent of these conventional platforms, ensuring reliability and access regardless of location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for digital creators. PayPal and Stripe may promise immediate transactions, but issues like account freezes and geographic restrictions can delay or even deny access to funds. Additionally, both platforms charge fees that can accumulate quickly. Sovereign commerce solutions, such as NOWPayments, offer automatic on-chain crypto payment verification for just 0.5% per transaction without any KYC requirements. This means creators not only receive faster payments but also retain more of their earnings, allowing for sustainable business growth.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure liberates creators from platform restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With traditional platforms, creators often face limitations on ownership and control over their digital products. PayPal and Stripe can impose restrictions on how digital goods are delivered, and they maintain access to transaction data. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers full ownership; once deployed, creators have complete autonomy over their stores and data. For instance, with the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can automate product delivery and payment processing, ensuring a seamless experience for their customers while retaining control over their assets.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're in a country where major platforms are unavailable, investing in sovereign commerce infrastructure is the smartest move. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution that can be deployed in 48 hours, allowing you to quickly establish your store and start selling. Assess your product offerings, consider the need for automation, and prioritize ownership to make an informed decision that will serve your long-term goals.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Control your data and transactions without fear of account freezes.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
